mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(submitted_at) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySubmittedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(finished_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySuccessCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(finished_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayFailedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waitingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningCount, COUNT(*) AS totalTaskCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / COUNT(*) END AS successRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, finished_at) / 1000 ELSE NULL END )), 0) AS averageProcessingTimeMs FROM analysis_task

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submittedDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS submittedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount FROM ( SELECT DATE(submitted_at) AS submittedDate, status FROM analysis_task WHERE submitted_at >= #{startDate} ) trend GROUP BY submittedDate ORDER BY submittedDate
